title: Photosynthesis (sample talk)

segments.text: Plants make their own food using sunlight.
Leaves take in carbon dioxide from the air.
Roots take in water from the soil.
Using the sunlight, the plant turns them into sugar and oxygen.
The sugar feeds the plant, and the oxygen goes back into the air.

summary: A short talk explaining that plants make their own food from sunlight, using carbon dioxide from the air and water from the soil, and that they release oxygen.
keyPoints: Plants make their own food using sunlight.
Leaves take in carbon dioxide and roots take in water.
The plant makes sugar and releases oxygen.
